item.title: @faytuksnetwork: Al-Mada reports that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s unannounced visit to Tehran resulted in a mediation proposal un
item.description: Al-Mada reports that Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s unannounced visit to Tehran resulted in a mediation proposal under which the U.S. would accept four of Iran’s seven demands while contesting the remaining three. The reported US concessions include allowing Iran to retain its nuclear materials, lifting the naval blockade, and ending hostilities across the region, including in Lebanon.

item.title: @faytuksnetwork: Irish and Northern Irish schools have also received "threatening messages" and "bomb threats" this morning, The Irish Ti
item.description: Irish and Northern Irish schools have also received "threatening messages" and "bomb threats" this morning, The Irish Times and BBC report. The Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) have said they "have not been made aware of any evidence of any credible threat to schools" and as such evacuations have not taken place. The Education Authority is said to be liaising with PSNI and affected schools.
